title: What Moves the Ceiling on Automated Audit: from General Code to Scientific Code, Results and Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.23250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Models increasingly check what other models write. We study one shipped arrangement, in which an auditor from a different vendor reads the work and deterministic checks verify what code can verify, and measure its limits against ground truth no model supplies. On general-purpose code with hidden tests, eight readings of the auditor reach 30.0% recall [20.0, 40.7] at 16.0% [10.1, 22.3] flags on correct code, with diminishing returns and no plateau. The reading model (confounded with its sampling), one rulebook sentence and the decision rule each move that figure, and much of what is missed is, on a post hoc rating, behaviour the specification never determined. In three preregistered science studies, checking that reported numbers trace to their sources flagged all 49 inconsistent reports and none of 25 consistent fabrications, of which the model auditor flagged 23 (21 with a sound finding, post hoc); on data, a documentation-derived val

translated_title: 是什么决定了自动化审计的上限：从通用代码到科学代码、结果与数据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.23250v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：模型越来越多地被用来检查其他模型所写的内容。我们研究了一种已实际部署的安排：由来自不同供应商的审计模型阅读工作成果，并由确定性检查验证代码所能验证的部分，然后在没有任何模型能够提供的真值（ground truth）之下测量其极限。在带有隐藏测试的通用代码上，审计模型的八次阅读达到 30.0% 的召回率 [20.0, 40.7]，同时在正确代码上的误报率为 16.0% [10.1, 22.3]，收益递减且没有出现平台期。阅读模型（与其采样方式相混淆）、规则手册中的一个句子以及决策规则各自都会改变这一数字；而根据事后评级，大部分被遗漏的内容其实是规范从未明确界定的行为。在三项预注册的科学研究中，检查报告中的数字能否溯源到其来源的确定性检查，标记出了全部 49 份不一致的报告，却没有标记出 25 份内部一致的伪造报告中的任何一份——而模型审计员标记出了其中 23 份（事后评定中 21 份的发现有据可依）；在数据方面，一种由文档推导出的验证……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文在真值基准上量化了“异厂商模型审计+确定性检查”这一自动化审计流程的能力上限：通用代码上召回率仅约 30% 且无饱和点，可通过阅读模型、规则与决策规则提升；而在科学结果核查中，数字溯源检查能识别全部 49 份不一致报告，模型审计则可额外发现 25 份内部一致伪造中的 23 份。
en_tdlr: This paper measures the ceiling of an automated model-audits-model pipeline against ground truth, showing only ~30% recall on general code with diminishing returns, and demonstrating that combining number-tracing checks with a cross-vendor model auditor flags all 49 inconsistent scientific reports and 23 of 25 internally consistent fabrications.
